[RFCS.9.5] A reader that does not implement checkpoint seeking MUST
still process the following `SchemaDef`/`Slot`/`FactAssert` atoms normally.
Such a reader skips the `Checkpoint` atom; the `SchemaDef`/`Slot`/`FactAssert` atoms that
follow are standard atoms and are processed as usual, appearing as
re-assertions.  Readers must handle duplicate assertions idempotently
(assert over the existing fact using the same `fact_id` within the
segment).
